key_findings: EVALUATION v3 COMPLETE: Comprehensive adversarial evaluation on expanded slice (1,200 decisions) with 5 benchmarks (language dominance, jurist pairwise, Jurivoc hierarchy alignment, scale stability, boilerplate resistance proxy)

center_projected_1000 (curated 1000-decision slice): PASSES adversarial gates (LangDom=0.7632 < 0.85, JuristPref=0.5275 > 0.5), Jurivoc NMI=0.4657, Scale Stability=1.0000, FAILS Boilerplate Resistance PROXY (0.5035 > 0.3). 4/5 benchmarks PASS.

center_projected_1200 (full 1200-decision slice): FAILS jurist pairwise preference (0.4912 < 0.5) and boilerplate resistance proxy (0.5296). 3/5 benchmarks PASS. The expanded slice includes ~200 additional decisions that degrade jurist preference.

signal_outcome_tfidf passes adversarial gates (LangDom=0.4463, JuristPref=0.7177) but FAILS Jurivoc (0.0000) and Scale Stability (0.0000) — CONFIRMS overclustering artifact (1→1000 clusters). Adversarial PASS is FALSE POSITIVE.
ALL signal ablation hybrids FAIL jurist pairwise preference (>0.5 threshold). Best hybrid: hybrid_cited_decisions_0.3 (LangDom=0.7989 PASS, JuristPref=0.4555 FAIL).
ALL hybrids with α≥0.5 FAIL language dominance (>0.85 threshold). Hybrids with α=0.3 pass LangDom but fail JuristPref.
Jurivoc hierarchy alignment (legal_area proxy): center_projected achieves NMI=0.43-0.47. Legal_area signals achieve higher NMI (0.75-0.79) but fail adversarial gates.
Scale stability (frozen PCA): center_projected achieves perfect 1.0000 consistency. signal_outcome_tfidf fails (0.0000) due to overclustering.
Boilerplate resistance PROXY (language dominance): ALL representations FAIL (>0.3 threshold). center_projected: 0.50-0.53. Signal/hybrid: 0.57-1.0. This measures LANGUAGE DOMINANCE, not boilerplate.

REAL Boilerplate Resistance (v3_boilerplate_real): TF-IDF signals show 89-93% neighbor preservation when procedural boilerplate removed. Resistance score 0.07-0.11 (LOW = GOOD). Neighbors driven by SUBSTANTIVE content, not boilerplate. v3 proxy was MISNAMED — it measured language dominance, not boilerplate.
NO representation passes all 5 benchmarks. center_projected on curated 1000-slice is closest (4/5). Factory direction v6 baseline (center_projected) validated as reference.

critical_findings.center_projected_validated: ONLY representation passing BOTH adversarial gates (LangDom < 0.85, JuristPref > 0.5) on curated 1000-decision slice. On expanded 1200 slice, jurist preference drops to 0.4912.
critical_findings.adversarial_gap_confirmed: Fractal-map harness promise ≠ adversarial robustness. Signal ablation hybrids excel at Jurivoc NMI but fail jurist pairwise preference. Fundamental gap between taxonomic alignment and neighbor-level legal relevance.
critical_findings.signal_outcome_artifact: signal_outcome_tfidf passes adversarial gates but overclusters (1→1000), achieving 0.0000 Jurivoc NMI and 0.0000 scale stability. Adversarial PASS is false positive.
critical_findings.boilerplate_proxy_misnamed: v3 'boilerplate resistance' benchmark measured LANGUAGE DOMINANCE (fraction of decisions with >80% same-language neighbors), not actual boilerplate influence. Real boilerplate test shows TF-IDF neighbors 93% stable when boilerplate removed — procedural boilerplate does NOT dominate neighbor structure.
critical_findings.language_dominance_real_challenge: Language dominance IS a real problem (cross-lingual alignment failure), but it is DISTINCT from boilerplate resistance. center_projected achieves ~50% language dominance due to partial cross-lingual alignment from sentence transformer.
critical_findings.expanded_slice_degradation: center_projected jurist preference drops from 0.5275 (1000-slice) to 0.4912 (1200-slice). The ~200 additional decisions introduce language-dominated neighbors.
critical_findings.jurivoc_vs_adversarial_tradeoff: Legal_area signals achieve high Jurivoc NMI (0.75-0.79) but fail adversarial gates. center_projected achieves moderate Jurivoc NMI (0.43-0.47) but passes adversarial gates on curated slice.

real_boilerplate_resistance_tfidf.interpretation: High neighbor preservation (0.89-0.93) = neighbors STABLE when boilerplate removed = boilerplate NOT driving neighbors. Low resistance score (0.07-0.11) = GOOD. Proxy rate 1.0 = language dominance (different phenomenon).
